name: com.darsh.multipleimageselect.activities.ImageSelectActivity
description: CrazyCodeBoy MultipleImageSelect is a photo-picker SDK, also published as a WDEO3601-maintained fork. This screen shows photos from the album selected in the picker, lets the user select several images, and returns the selection to the app.
disableEffect: Apps that use this picker can no longer select photos and return them through this screen.
